description: Create your own dataset on autario and append rows to it, private by default, readable through the same tools as World Bank or FRED data.

action.description: Which operation to run. create_dataset = a new empty dataset, needs title; write_rows = append rows to your dataset, needs dataset_id, rows.

category.description: Category for the dataset (e.g. "Finance & Economics", "Health & Society", "Environment")

dataset_id.description: The UUID of the dataset to append rows to

description.description: Description of the dataset contents, source, and methodology

is_public.description: Whether the dataset is publicly visible (default false)

rows.description: Array of row objects where keys are column names (e.g. [{"country": "USA", "year": "2024", "value": "25000"}])

title.description: Dataset title (e.g. "Global CO2 Emissions by Country")

name: write_data
